reviews.comment:
No vayan  Son una vergüenza. Estuve esperando a que le cargaran NAFTA al auto de adelante y cuando terminó, en vez de cargarme a mi empezó a cargar al auto que había llegado recién...que casualmente había hablado con el playero...me baje, se lo dije y encima me maltrato. Así funcióna este país...con unos pesos se arregla todo..

(Translated by Google)
Don't go there. They're a disgrace. I was waiting for them to fill up the car in front of me, and when they finished, instead of filling me up, they started filling up the car that had just arrived...who, coincidentally, had spoken to the attendant...I got out, told him, and on top of that, he treated me rudely. That's how this country works...everything can be fixed with a few bucks.
